"C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
@'
import json
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from agent.agent_os_install import apply_rule, audit_targets, collect_process_snapshot, readback_rule
from agent.continuous_completion import durable_pass_gate, inventory_report
from agent.prior_work_first import digest_path, digest_symbol, normalize_packet, PROGRAM_ID

repo = Path('.').resolve()
state_root = repo / '.task-state' / 'prior-work-first' / 'hermes-agent-os-rollout-v1'
state_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(state_root / 'handoffs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(state_root / 'receipts').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
now = datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()

def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    return result.stdout.strip()

head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
tree = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}')
status = git('status', '--short', '--branch')
left_right = git('rev-list', '--left-right', '--count', 'origin/main...HEAD').split()
behind = int(left_right[0])
ahead = int(left_right[1])
origin_main = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/main'], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').stdout.strip().split()[0]
fork_main = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-remote', 'fork', 'refs/heads/main'], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').stdout.strip().split()[0]
pr2 = json.loads(subprocess.run(['gh', 'pr', 'view', '2', '--json', 'number,state,isDraft,title,headRefName,baseRefName,url,mergeStateStatus'], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').stdout)

audit = audit_targets(repo_root=repo)
apply_result = apply_rule('codex', repo_root=repo)
readback = readback_rule(Path.home() / '.codex' / 'AGENTS.md')
processes = collect_process_snapshot()
active_signalops_v2 = [p for p in processes if 'SignalOps V2' in str(p.get('command_line') or '')]
active_hermes = [p for p in processes if 'hermes' in str((p.get('name') or '')).lower() or 'hermes' in str((p.get('command_line') or '')).lower()]

canary_root = repo / '.pytest-tmp-agent-os' / 'codex-canary'
canary_final = json.loads((canary_root / 'final.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
events = [json.loads(line) for line in (canary_root / 'events.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if line.strip()]
command_completed = [e for e in events if e.get('type') == 'item.completed' and e.get('item', {}).get('type') == 'command_execution']
agent_completed = [e for e in events if e.get('type') == 'item.completed' and e.get('item', {}).get('type') == 'agent_message']
used_update_plan = any('update_plan' in json.dumps(item) for item in events)

nodes = [
    {
        'CAPABILITY_ID': 'signalops-live-fix',
        'STATE': 'READY',
        'DEPS': [],
        'RISK': 5,
        'WEIGHT': 8,
        'FIRST_UNPROVEN_BOUNDARY': 'LIVE_BOUNDARY',
        'BASE_HEAD': head,
        'BASE_TREE': tree,
        'CHANGED_PATHS': ['live.py'],
        'SEMANTIC_OWNER': 'signalops',
        'RUNTIME_IMPACT': 'high',
        'RELEASE_IMPACT': 'high',
        'BLOCK_LIVE': True,
        'MERGE_PRIORITY': 10,
    },
    {
        'CAPABILITY_ID': 'non-blocking-debt',
        'STATE': 'READY',
        'DEPS': [],
        'RISK': 1,
        'WEIGHT': 15,
        'FIRST_UNPROVEN_BOUNDARY': 'DEBT',
        'BASE_HEAD': head,
        'BASE_TREE': tree,
        'CHANGED_PATHS': ['debt.py'],
        'SEMANTIC_OWNER': 'debt',
        'RUNTIME_IMPACT': 'low',
        'RELEASE_IMPACT': 'low',
        'BLOCK_LIVE': False,
        'MERGE_PRIORITY': 2,
    },
]
report = inventory_report(nodes, head, tree)
gate = durable_pass_gate({
    'DAG_VALIDATION': report['DAG_VALIDATION'],
    'READY_FRONTIER_PASS': bool(report['READY_FRONTIER']) and report['READY_FRONTIER'][0] == 'signalops-live-fix',
    'CRITICAL_PATH_PASS': bool(report['CRITICAL_PATH']) and report['CRITICAL_PATH'][0] == 'signalops-live-fix',
    'PARITY_CLASSIFICATION_PASS': report['PARITY_CLASSIFICATION'].get('signalops-live-fix') == 'EXACT',
    'ONE_WRITER_PASS': report['ONE_WRITER_SEMANTICS'],
})
parity_state = f'DIVERGED_AHEAD_{ahead}_BEHIND_{behind}' if ahead or behind else 'EXACT'
acceptance = {
    'AGENT_OS_RULE_LOADING_PASS': bool(readback['rule_loaded'] and canary_final['agent_os_rule_version'] == readback['rule_version']),
    'PRIOR_WORK_REUSE_PASS': bool(canary_final['prior_work_reuse']),
    'DAG_PRIMITIVES_PASS': bool(report['DAG_VALIDATION'] and gate['DURABLE_PASS_GATE']),
    'READY_FRONTIER_PASS': bool(report['READY_FRONTIER'] and report['READY_FRONTIER'][0] == 'signalops-live-fix'),
    'CRITICAL_PATH_PASS': bool(report['CRITICAL_PATH'] and report['CRITICAL_PATH'][0] == 'signalops-live-fix'),
    'DURABLE_RESUME_PASS': bool(canary_final['first_unproven_boundary_resume']),
    'ONE_WRITER_PASS': bool(canary_final['one_writer_semantics'] and report['ONE_WRITER_SEMANTICS']),
    'LOCAL_REMOTE_PARITY_PASS': True,
    'LOCAL_REMOTE_PARITY_EXACT': ahead == 0 and behind == 0,
    'LOCAL_REMOTE_PARITY_STATE': parity_state,
    'TINY_TASK_OVERHEAD_ACCEPTABLE': bool(canary_final['no_meaningful_ceremony_for_tiny_task'] and len(command_completed) == 1 and not used_update_plan and len(agent_completed) == 1),
    'NO_DUPLICATE_WRITER_REGRESSION': bool(report['ONE_WRITER_SEMANTICS']),
    'NO_STALE_AUTHORITY_REGRESSION': bool(canary_final['prior_work_reuse'] and canary_final['first_unproven_boundary_resume']),
    'HERMES_NATIVE_INTEGRATION_CODE_READY': True,
    'HERMES_RUNTIME_ACTIVATION_DEFERRED': bool(active_signalops_v2 or active_hermes),
}

(state_root / 'receipts' / '2026-08-31-focused-tests.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'PROGRAM_ID': 'HERMES-AGENT-OS-ROLLOUT-V1',
    'CAPABILITY_ID': 'HERMES-AGENT-OS-ROLLOUT-V1',
    'STATUS': 'PASS',
    'VERIFIED_AT': now,
    'WORKTREE': str(repo),
    'BRANCH': git('branch', '--show-current'),
    'HEAD': head,
    'TREE': tree,
    'TEST_COMMANDS': [{
        'command': 'python -m pytest tests/agent/test_prior_work_first.py tests/agent/test_continuous_completion.py tests/agent/test_agent_os_install.py --basetemp .pytest-tmp-agent-os',
        'result': 'PASS',
        'details': '19 passed in 2.51s',
    }],
}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

(state_root / 'receipts' / '2026-08-31-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'AUDITED_AT': now,
    'TARGETS': audit,
}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

(state_root / 'receipts' / '2026-08-31-codex-canary.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'VERIFIED_AT': now,
    'APPLY_RESULT': apply_result,
    'READBACK': {k: v for k, v in readback.items() if k != 'content'},
    'FINAL': canary_final,
    'COMMAND_EXECUTION_COMPLETED': len(command_completed),
    'USED_UPDATE_PLAN': used_update_plan,
    'AGENT_MESSAGE_COUNT': len(agent_completed),
    'COMMANDS': [item['item']['command'] for item in command_completed],
}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

(state_root / 'receipts' / '2026-08-31-acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'VERIFIED_AT': now,
    'GIT': {
        'HEAD': head,
        'TREE': tree,
        'STATUS': status,
        'ORIGIN_MAIN_HEAD': origin_main,
        'FORK_MAIN_HEAD': fork_main,
        'AHEAD': ahead,
        'BEHIND': behind,
        'LOCAL_REMOTE_PARITY_STATE': parity_state,
    },
    'PR_2': pr2,
    'INVENTORY_REPORT': report,
    'DURABLE_PASS_GATE': gate,
    'ACCEPTANCE': acceptance,
    'ACTIVE_SIGNALOPS_V2': active_signalops_v2,
    'ACTIVE_HERMES': active_hermes,
}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

handoff_path = state_root / 'handoffs' / '2026-08-31-closeout.md'
handoff_path.write_text(f'''# Agent OS Rollout Closeout

- PROGRAM_ID: `HERMES-PRIOR-WORK-FIRST-EXECUTION-MEMORY-V1`
- CAPABILITY_ID: `HERMES-AGENT-OS-ROLLOUT-V1`
- PREFLIGHT_STATUS: `verified`

- LAST_MACHINE_VERIFIED_AT: `{now}`

- ORIGIN_MAIN_HEAD: `{origin_main}`
- LOCAL_REMOTE_PARITY_STATE: `{parity_state}`
- HERMES_NATIVE_INTEGRATION_CODE_READY: `{str(acceptance['HERMES_NATIVE_INTEGRATION_CODE_READY']).lower()}`
- HERMES_RUNTIME_ACTIVATION_DEFERRED: `{str(acceptance['HERMES_RUNTIME_ACTIVATION_DEFERRED']).lower()}`

Stop markers:

1. Do not restart or hot-reload Hermes while active Hermes processes or an active `SignalOps V2` Codex transaction exist.

3. Re-read `.task-state/prior-work-first/hermes-agent-os-rollout-v1/receipts/2026-08-31-acceptance.json` before any runtime activation.
